Installation:

  1. Install greasemonkey extension for firefox (or a similar extension for other browsers)
  2. Download and save this: http://pastebin.com/raw.php?i=1q4FF5fJ as rtov.user.js
  3. Open the script in greasemonkey and install it
  4. Type reddit.com/r/news -> get redirected to voat.co/v/news
